candidateSpec.description: Screen all legal root board actions, refine top K=2, then conditionally expand to K=4 and K=6 using only frozen observable winner stability and objective-scale margin rules. If ambiguity remains after K=6, refine every remaining root exactly. Stop and menu reroll remain represented at every stage.
candidateSpec.selectionRule: Among qualifying candidates, select highest median speedup; break ties by lower exact-fallback rate, then higher root-action agreement, then lower maximum oracle regret, then candidate id.
